key_insight: Swarmlet couples GPU-resident vortex-particle aerodynamics with multirotor flight dynamics and control, preserving wake impulse while scaling to a 100-quadrotor demonstration.
engineering_relevance: The solver supports unsteady rotor-wake and vehicle-interaction studies for multirotor design and closed-loop formation analysis.
method: Meshless reformulated vortex-particle LES with evolving cores and a treecode whose far field introduces no regularization error.
Dynamic eddy viscosity and globally corrected exchange and relaxation conserve total vorticity and linear impulse.
Three rotor-model fidelities coupled to six-degree-of-freedom vehicles and flight control, with connected circulation shedding.
evidence_signal: Reported results include agreement with direct summation to 5×10⁻⁷, third-order time convergence, hover thrust within 2% without calibration, calibrated thrust and torque within 3.2%, and near-wake relative L² differences of 0.08–0.21 against PIV.
watch_item: The 100-quadrotor demonstration uses coarser settings; the abstract does not establish swarm-scale accuracy or runtime.
paper_title: Swarmlet: a GPU-resident reformulated vortex particle method for coupled multirotor aerodynamics and flight dynamics
